referenceNotes.en: M02 left: teenage face; v3 handover: denim outfit; GA05: paint medium only.

prompt: Create a professional CHARACTER CONTINUITY SHEET in HAND-PAINTED WATERCOLOR AND OPAQUE GOUACHE on warm ivory textured paper. Preserve the EXACT fictional identity from the named photographic reference: same face shape, eye spacing, nose, brows, mouth, natural skin tone, hair and age. The LAST reference is PAINT MEDIUM ONLY: broad opaque brush planes, translucent washes, tactile dry edges and reserved paper. Do not borrow faces, costume, pose or scenery from the style reference. Confident visible painted shapes, gently simplified volumes and expressive detailed face. NOT a filtered photograph, NOT 3D, NOT glossy anime. No lettering, names, captions, dates, diagram arrows, watermarks or graphic logos. No tattoos, extra limbs or invented facial marks. Plain warm ivory paper background throughout. Landscape 16:9. REFERENCE1 use ONLY the YOUNG teenage girl on LEFT, same daughter aged16 in1995, Luna's future mother. Reference2 supplies full denim outfit ONLY, do not draw father/chairs/shoes held aloft. Preserve the young daughter's exact softly rounded cheeks, brows, brown eyes, warm brown skin and shoulder-length loose dark curls. Distinct from Luna: not a ponytail or charcoal tee. Blue denim jacket and blue straight jeans with rolled ankles over a plain ivory tee. Black high-top inherited Converse at her feet, cream laces/ivory rubber, small cream stitched repair on outer RIGHT shoe above rubber edge, inner badges only; no tan blob on toe. Ordinary teenage proportions, no adult glamour or makeup. SHEET LAYOUT: exactly THREE clearly separated equal vertical panels: LEFT full-body FRONT standing view, CENTER full-body BACK standing view, RIGHT enlarged THREE-QUARTER head-and-shoulders portrait. Both standing figures are fully framed from top of head through complete shoes, comfortable margin at top and bottom. Same outfit and proportions across every panel. Relaxed neutral posture, empty hands, restrained expression. No additional people or scenery.

qa.fr: Maman adolescente distincte de Luna, denim et boucles cohérents. La petite réparation de la chaussure droite est peu lisible ; les gros plans devront reprendre la fiche produit. Aquarelle plus transparente, visage détaillé proche de la photo.
qa.en: Teenage Mom remains distinct from Luna, with consistent denim and curls. The right-shoe repair is not clearly legible; close-ups must use the product master. More translucent watercolor with a detailed face closer to photography.

visualReview.method: Local three-model contact-sheet comparison; final newborn Seedream image also viewed full size.
